# Convert PNG to JPG

- Route: `/tools/convert-png-to-jpg`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `convert-png-to-jpg`

## Summary

Turn large PNG screenshots and graphics into small, universally compatible JPG photos in seconds. (Image tools)

## Details

PNG is a lossless format, which makes it perfect for screenshots and graphics but often far larger than it needs to be for photos. Converting PNG to JPG can shrink a file by 5–10× with no visible difference for photographic content. Media Manipulator converts your PNG to a clean JPG at the quality you choose — free, online, and with no signup.
### What it does
- Converts any .png image to a standard .jpg (JPEG) file.
- Lets you pick JPG quality so you can balance file size against fidelity.
- Flattens transparency onto a solid background, since JPG has no alpha channel.
- The pixels you see stay the same; only the file is re-encoded from PNG into JPG.
### How to use it
1. Upload PNG: Drop in a .png screenshot, graphic, or photo.
2. Pick JPG quality: 85 is a balanced default; lower it for smaller files.
3. Encode JPG: ImageMagick re-encodes your image as a JPEG.
4. Download JPG: Save a smaller, universally compatible .jpg file.
### Supported formats
- Input: png
- Output: jpg
- Transparent PNG areas are flattened onto a solid background because JPG has no transparency.
### Technical details
- Quality 85 is the long-standing sweet spot — above ~92 you mostly add file size with little visible gain.
- A photographic PNG often drops from several megabytes to a few hundred kilobytes as a JPG.
- For graphics with sharp edges or text, PNG or WebP usually look cleaner than JPG at the same size.
- If your PNG has transparency you want to keep, convert to WebP instead — JPG cannot store an alpha channel.
### Use cases
- Shrinking screenshots: Turn a heavy PNG screenshot into a lightweight JPG for email or chat.
- Uploading photos: Convert a photographic PNG to JPG to meet a site’s format requirement.
- Print and photo labs: Most labs require JPG — convert before you order.
- Faster web pages: Replace large PNG photos with compact JPGs to cut page weight.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert a PNG to JPG for free?
A: Upload your .png above, choose a JPG quality, and click convert. The download is a standard .jpg file.
Q: Will converting PNG to JPG reduce quality?
A: JPG is lossy, so there is a small quality trade-off. At quality 85–90 the difference is invisible for photos. For graphics with sharp text, keep PNG or use WebP.
Q: What happens to transparency when I convert PNG to JPG?
A: JPG does not support transparency, so transparent areas are flattened onto a solid background. If you need to keep transparency, convert PNG to WebP instead.
Q: Why is my PNG so much bigger than the JPG?
A: PNG is lossless and stores every pixel exactly, which is large for photos. JPG uses perceptual compression, so photographic images shrink dramatically with little visible change.
